description: Client-only, needs enableSupervisedControl. Hold one movement key (forward, back, left or right) for a few ticks (1-10, 20 ticks = 1 s), then release it. One call is one approved action: a new move needs a new call. Refused while the player holds that key, a screen is open, or movement/navigation runs. Answers with outcome applied, not_applied, interrupted (STOP, the key was released, the world or dimension changed) or uncertain, plus the position before and after.

ticks.description: How long to hold the key, in client ticks.

name: supervised_input
